# Origenal Story

> Origenal Story is a Barcelona-based international growth and storytelling partner for food, ingredient and purpose-led brands. It connects Brazil and Europe through market intelligence, brand positioning and storytelling, distributor and buyer connections, trade-fair activation and consumer insight.

Based in Barcelona, Spain. Languages: English · Español · Português · Français. Contact: info@origenalstory.com.
Areas served: Europe, Spain, France, Benelux, Germany, Brazil.

## Services

- [Read the market](https://origenalstory.com/services/read-the-market/): Market & go-to-market intelligence. Where can your product create value in Europe? Steps: Explore the market; Identify the gaps & opportunities; Understand your new universe; Check claims and verifications; Identify your channel & adapt your story.
- [Understand what matters](https://origenalstory.com/services/understand-what-matters/): Consumer insight & market activation. Activate what resonates. Steps: Understand your consumer; Decode your market; Translate insight into opportunity; Activate, test & learn.
- [Create the right connections](https://origenalstory.com/services/create-the-right-connections/): Channel, distributor & buyer intelligence. Identify the optimal route to market. Steps: Find your route to market; Identify the right players; Prioritise your targets; Create the conversation and turn it into momentum.
- [Make your story travel](https://origenalstory.com/services/make-your-story-travel/): Brand positioning & storytelling. Your story may be clear at home. Will it stay the same when you export it? Steps: Tap into your Origenal Story; Chameleonise your story; Define your own commercial story; Your story is alive.

## Founder

- [Claudia Vasquez Alarcón](https://origenalstory.com/about/founder/): Built from market experience, journalistic insight and human connection. Journalist, B2B marketer and international consultant. Her profile is unusual, and that is what makes it useful: the ability to find stories (journalism), the ability to sell them (B2B marketing) and a sector she knows inside out (food and ingredients).

## Key facts

- 25+ years in international marketing, branding and business development
- 10+ years as a B2B trade journalist in Europe
- 100+ strategic projects
- 20+ countries we have worked with

## Selected work

- [Brazilian Açaí Producer & Exporter: EU Market Opportunity Mapping for a Brazilian Açaí Producer](https://origenalstory.com/work/brazilian-acai-eu-mapping/): EU market opportunity mapping for a Brazilian açaí producer and exporter. Origenal Story analysed target-market potential, buyer relevance and expansion priorities to support a clearer, more strategic European market entry.
- [Spanish Berry Producers / Perlite: Spanish Berries / Perlite — Market Assessment](https://origenalstory.com/work/spanish-berries-perlite/): Grounded market assessment for a Perlite opportunity linked to Spanish berry producers. Research-based work with local contacts and a local call centre agency turned assumptions into informed decisions.
- [Pumpskin & Lévere: European Market Opportunity Mapping — French Organic Cosmetics & Brazilian Nutraceutical](https://origenalstory.com/work/pumpskin-levere-eu-mapping/): European market opportunity mapping for a 6-SKU portfolio across two brands — Pumpskin (French premium organic beauty) and Lévere (Brazilian nutraceutical). 2-3 priority countries identified with a clear entry roadmap.
- [Dutch Food Service Brand: Plant-Based Seafood — Market Prioritisation in France & Spain](https://origenalstory.com/work/dutch-foodservice-plantbased/): Market prioritisation for a Dutch plant-based seafood brand entering Southern Europe. France identified as the strongest near-term opportunity over Spain, driven by food service maturity.
- [Perlite Project: Perlite Project — Market Entry Strategy & Sector Targeting](https://origenalstory.com/work/perlite-eu-entry/): Market entry strategy and sector targeting for the European Perlite opportunity. Clear view of relevance, sector fit and entry priorities — moving the client from assumptions to a strategic view.
- [Lévere: Lévere — Spain Market Access & Distributor Search](https://origenalstory.com/work/levere-spain-distributors/): Spain market access and distributor search for Lévere (Brazilian nutraceutical). 5 Spanish distributors connected in a single trade fair plus introductions to relevant influencers and importers.
- [Pumpskin: Pumpskin — Spanish Market Scouting & Entry Support](https://origenalstory.com/work/pumpskin-spain-entry/): Spanish market scouting and entry support for Pumpskin (French premium organic beauty). Entry activated through the Eco Living fair in Madrid with targeted outreach and commercial positioning.
- [Interior Luxury Design Brand: Interior Luxury Design Brand — European Market Orientation](https://origenalstory.com/work/interior-luxury-barcelona/): European market orientation for a luxury interior design brand. Barcelona recommended as strategic base, aligned with the brand's aesthetic, audience and commercial-cultural resonance.
- [Rude Health: Rude Health — Packaging Content & Market Adaptation for Spain](https://origenalstory.com/work/rude-health-packaging-spain/): Packaging content and market adaptation of Rude Health products for the Spanish market. Ingredients, claims and brand language adapted with the right balance of clarity, local relevance and brand consistency.
- [Abbot Kinney's: Abbot Kinney's — Packaging & Marketing Adaptation for Export Markets](https://origenalstory.com/work/abbot-kinneys-export-adaptation/): Packaging and marketing adaptation for Abbot Kinney's to resonate effectively in export contexts while remaining true to brand positioning. Clearer, more relevant communication for international audiences.
- [Flores: Flores — Presentation Adaptation for a Dutch E-commerce Platform](https://origenalstory.com/work/flores-dutch-ecommerce/): Corporate presentation adapted for the commercial logic of a Dutch e-commerce platform. Clearer positioning and stronger commercial impact for the business conversation.
- [Passina: Passina — International Brand Repositioning Around SIAL Paris](https://origenalstory.com/work/passina-international-repositioning/): International brand repositioning for Passina, opening new B2B conversations across food, cosmetics and nutraceuticals around SIAL Paris. Broader, more strategic story across categories.
- [Mycogenius: Mycogenius — Mission, Vision, Values & Brand Foundations](https://origenalstory.com/work/mycogenius-brand-foundations/): Brand foundations for Mycogenius (premium functional mushrooms). Mission, vision, values, philosophy and positioning aligned with premium quality, natural credibility and consumer trust.
- [Halitta Foods / Hauwa: Halitta Foods / Hauwa — Brand Positioning for International Growth](https://origenalstory.com/work/halitta-hauwa-positioning/): Brand positioning for Halitta Foods / Hauwa to define identity, clarify value and position the brand for growth across international markets. A clearer platform for future communication and market relevance.
- [Halitta Foods / Hauwa: Halitta Foods / Hauwa — Brand Storytelling Foundations](https://origenalstory.com/work/halitta-hauwa-storytelling/): Brand storytelling foundations for Halitta Foods / Hauwa. Mission, vision, values and strategic storytelling shaped around identity, purpose and emotional connection with international audiences.
- [Passina: Passina — Creative Storytelling for International Relevance](https://origenalstory.com/work/passina-creative-storytelling/): Creative storytelling refresh for Passina — a broader, more compelling brand story across food, cosmetics and nutraceuticals. Deeper international relevance and B2B coherence.
- [Eric Boehm: Eric Boehm — Storytelling for a Nature-Led Premium Craft Brand](https://origenalstory.com/work/eric-boehm-nettle-storytelling/): Strategic storytelling for Eric Boehm's nettle-fibre craft brand. A narrative around material nobility, nature, craftsmanship and emotional value — connecting with audiences who appreciate noble natural materials.
- [Naturamus: Naturamus — International Press Activation at in-cosmetics Global Paris](https://origenalstory.com/work/naturamus-incosmetics-press/): International press activation for Naturamus at in-cosmetics Global Paris 2024. Press release development, international media outreach and follow-up turned trade fair presence into industry recognition.
- [UEBT: UEBT — International Press Relations for Sourcing with Respect Paris](https://origenalstory.com/work/uebt-sourcing-with-respect/): International press relations for UEBT's Sourcing with Respect conference in Paris. Targeted media outreach and journalist engagement turned the event into a stronger platform for visibility and meaningful sector conversations.
- [Natural & Organic Products Trade Fair, Madrid: Natural & Organic Madrid — Event Activation for Brazilian & French Markets](https://origenalstory.com/work/natural-organic-madrid-activation/): Event activation as sales agent for the Brazilian and French markets around the Madrid edition of Natural & Organic Products. Targeted outreach and market-facing promotion across both markets.
- [International B2B Media Collaborations: International B2B Media Collaborations — Advertising Activation Across Trade Publications](https://origenalstory.com/work/b2b-media-collaborations/): Advertising and visibility activation through specialised B2B trade publications — Eurofresh Distribution (Europe), Portal Frutícola (Chile), European Dairy Magazine (Germany), Organic Wellness (Canada). Credible professional reach for sector campaigns.
